steps.title: Worked example
steps.body: Q: Write a function that reads a file of integers and returns the median --- Solution: def median_from_file(filename): with open(filename) as f: nums = sorted(int(line.strip()) for line in f if line.strip()) n = len(nums) if n == 0: return None mid = n // 2 return nums[mid] if n % 2 else (nums[mid-1] + nums[mid]) / 2
